description: This file defines the LocalDb class, a singleton interface for managing a local SQLite database using the sqflite package. It handles database initialization, schema creation, migrations (from version 1 to 2), and provides methods for CRUD operations related to users, attendance records, and pending synchronization queues in an offline/online attendance tracking application.

classes.name: LocalDb
classes.description: A singleton class providing methods to interact with a local SQLite database, including initialization, schema creation, migrations, and data manipulation for users, attendance, and sync queue.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the database connection, creating schema and performing migrations if necessary.

methods.name: insertUser
methods.description: Inserts or replaces a user record in the 'users' table.

methods.name: getUser
methods.description: Retrieves the current user record, if any.

methods.name: clearUser
methods.description: Deletes all user records, effectively logging out the user.

methods.name: addAttendance
methods.description: Adds a new attendance record with optional student name and period.

methods.name: getDaily
methods.description: Fetches all attendance records for a specific date.

methods.name: getWeekly
methods.description: Fetches attendance records within a specific date range.

methods.name: queuePending
methods.description: Queues a payload for later synchronization.

methods.name: getPending
methods.description: Retrieves all pending sync payloads, ordered by creation time.
